verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:
“Sir, they speak of the one called ‘a trainee’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, sekho hotī”ti?

verses.english: “They train, mendicant, that’s why they’re called ‘a trainee’.

verses.pali: Adhisīlampi sikkhati, adhicittampi sikkhati, adhipaññampi sikkhati.
verses.english: They train in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.

verses.pali: Sikkhatīti kho, bhikkhu, tasmā sekhoti vuccatīti.
verses.english: They train, that’s why they’re called ‘a trainee’.
enlightenment follows in the same lifetime.
such a one, freed through enlightenment,
with the end of the fetters of continued existence:
